svg.aria-label: What's in the box. In the box, two kinds of hand-off. Ask, FIX-1816: the turn parks on a dispatched worker and resumes with its real answer, across a restart, the asked worker running once, bounded by a timeout, a depth cap and a cancel that reaches the child. Assign stays open, FIX-1817: an answered park resumes the same task session; a finished session answers follow-up questions and takes a follow-up task. Under both, the Layer 1 seam: a server-side resume, a wait binding, awaitDispatch with runOnce and resultOf, a worker that parks its row, and a durable test runtime. Built once elsewhere and consumed here: the child-finished notices from FIX-1794 P2, the settle-owed marker from FIX-1802, and the board's claim ticket or FIX-1791's delivery ledger as the one answer-once check; generator suspend and resume already ships. The app's: which kind to use per call, its timeout and depth values, and the Shift Manager composer, FIX-1764 and FIX-1765. Not built, below a fence: an untrusted external inbox, skill agents in any form, one merged kind, a request held open, parallel fan-in beyond one-at-a-time resume, a third answer-once check.

g.text: IN THE BOX — TWO KINDS OF HAND-OFF, BOTH SURVIVE A RESTART, THE WORK RUNS ONCE
ask · FIX-1816
the turn parks on a dispatched worker
and resumes with its real answer
across a restart · the asked worker runs once
bounded: a timeout · a depth cap · cancel reaches it
assign stays open · FIX-1817
an answered park resumes the same task session
which keeps what it did before it parked
finished: answers follow-up questions
and takes a follow-up task · never locks
the Layer 1 seam, D5: server-side resume · a wait binding · awaitDispatch (runOnce + resultOf)
a worker that asks parks its own row · a durable in-memory runtime for tests
BUILT ONCE ELSEWHERE, CONSUMED HERE · D2
the child-finished signal: completed · errored · parked · FIX-1794 P2
the durable owed marker: settle-owed · FIX-1802
one answer-once check: the claim ticket, or the delivery ledger
generator suspend and resume, as human approval uses it · ships
THE APP'S
ask or assign, per call · dispatch default
the timeout and the depth values
the finished-task composer
FIX-1764 · epic FIX-1765
NOT BUILT
no untrusted external inbox: "mailbox" stays reserved · no skill agents: in any form, no private team
no one merged kind · no request held open while it waits · no third answer-once check
no parallel fan-in beyond a correct one-at-a-time resume
